name: Shelly Dust & Vacuum
author: Gedas-dev
description: Switches a dust extractor and a vacuum pump, each through its own Shelly relay (Gen2 or newer) over the local network. The dust extractor follows the spindle: on at M3, off a few seconds after it stops. The vacuum pump is switched by hand unless you choose otherwise. Each can have an On / Off switch on the main screen (Auxiliary I/O), and a window shows both relays' live state.
